explanation: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel, and an important figure in Genesis. He was sold into slavery by his brothers, but ended up as a powerful man in Egypt.
Sons of Jacob and his wives, who became the ancestors of Israel's twelve tribes.
An ancient kingdom in Northeast Africa where Joseph lived and worked after being sold as a slave.
The supreme ruler of ancient Egypt, whom Joseph served under.
Also known as Israel, Jacob was the son of Isaac and grandson of Abraham. He had twelve sons who became the ancestors of Israel's twelve tribes.
The area that God promised to give to Abraham's descendants, and where Jacob's family originally came from.
A ceremony or act to honor and remember the dead, usually by placing the body in the ground or treating it with respect in another way.
The act of accepting others' mistakes and letting go of anger, bitterness, or revenge.
The concept referring to God's plan and purpose for humanity and the world.
